name: Pagination
description: Moves between pages of a long list, with the current page marked.

props.name: href
props.description: Builds a link for each page (links mode).

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Called with the page instead (buttons mode).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the navigation landmark. Default "Pagination".

a11y: A <nav> landmark; the current page has aria-current="page" and every page an aria-label.
Previous and Next are disabled at the ends; the gaps are hidden from assistive tech.
